title: IEA — Global EV Outlook
text: Electric car sales in India rose sharply in 2024, crossing 100,000 units in several months. Two-wheelers still make up most of India's EV fleet. Policy support and cheaper batteries are the main drivers.

title: FAME II and the 2024 EV policy
text: India's FAME II scheme subsidised electric two-wheelers and buses. A 2024 policy push added charging targets in cities. Refunds and subsidies can change year to year, so always check the current gazette.

title: Battery prices 2015-2025
text: Lithium-ion pack prices fell from over $1000 per kWh in 2010 to well under $150 per kWh in the mid-2020s. Cheaper packs made small EVs viable in India. Prices can bounce when metals spike.
